name: QloApps
description: QloApps is a Free and Open-source hotel management and reservation system to take a hotel business online. QloApps offers a Property Management System (PMS), a Booking Engine, and an attractive Hotel Website. Elevate hotel operations with QloApps to streamline processes and provide an enhanced experience for both hoteliers and guests.

latest_release.name: QloApps 1.8.0
latest_release.body:
## Added Features:
  - #1786: No Show and Cancellation booking status in back-office, and updated refund request management.
  - #1760: Tourism tax system with per-hotel configurable, rate tiers, child pricing, and exemption.
  - #1782: Implement Source & Business Source Management.
  - #1663: Filtered responses for the QloApps bookings API.
  - #1791: Hotel reports module and functions needed for reports in their respective classes.
  - #1765: Image categorisation for hotel images at back-office.
  - #1714: Add CronTaskManager module in default QloApps.
  - #1671: Connected rooms feature to room management in back-office.
  - #1696: "QloApps Booking iCalendar (.ics) File Export" module in modules catalog.
  - #1610: Add new payment module (Duitku payment module ) in QloApps by default.
  - #1926: Qlositemap module for XML sitemaps generation, and fixed the HTML sitemap page.
  - #1838: Google hotel connector module in the default QloApps.
  - #1784: Hooks to add an extra column for additional information in order details in back-office.
  - #1952: Removed the default "Channel Manager Connector" module (qlochannelmanagerconnector); replaced by the combined "Channel Manager & API Connector" module (qlocmconnector), now bundled by default.

## Back Office:
- Improvements:
  - #1764: Dynamic homepage header media (image slider / video) display.
  - #1790: Reset button and available variables for email template translations in back-office.
  - #1803: Nationality field for customers in the back-office and front-office.
  - #1659: A new “Add Credit Slip” button has been added to Credit Slip controller in back-office.
  - #1762: Hotel selection in Cart Rule in back-office.
  - #1720: Arrival Date and Departure Date to the order list in back-office.
  - #1749: Booking calendar UI design in back-office.
  - #1717: Hotel amenities, and room features, and added room amenities.
  - #1698: Guest registration form button in order detail page, and made a new tab for Guest Registration in back office.
  - #1732: Fix service product price removal from cart total after occupancy change for orders created via the back-office.
  - #1691: Added view booking voucher button in order detail page in back-office to view booking voucher PDF.
  - #1664: Download and print functionality for payment receipts in the back-office.
  - #1656: Customer Service  Enhancements, bug fixes, and new features.
  - #1709: Remove extra hook related to KPI from AdminOrderController in the back-office.
  - #1665: Add configuration for infant age in GeneralSetting controller in back-office.
  - #1652: Preview of SEO fields added in back-office.
  - #1597: Add bulk action to enable or disable modules in back-office.
  - #1648: Debug Mode Option in Performance Tab.
  - #1618: Ensured that all order bills are cleared before the last room is checked out.
  - #1594: Refund remarks should be displayed in the PayPal transaction refund list in the Back Office.
  - #1601: Show a success message when adding or deleting a room from the cart via Book Now in the back-office.
  - #1568: Admin search configuration controller from the back-office.
  - #1830: Configurable options to show or hide tourism tax from the price summary on front office, invoices, and booking voucher.
  - #1827: Updated localization import flow in the back-office.
  - #1819: Replaced stale third-party URLs and branding with QloApps equivalents in the back-office.
  - #1828: Removed the "QloApps Booking iCalendar (.ics) File Export" module (added in #1696) from the modules catalog before release.
  - #1946: Make room disable dates independent of room status.
  - #1998: Redesigned the service products price-application popup to show which stay dates a service's price applies to, in both order edit (back-office) and the booking flow (front-office).

- Bugs Fixed:
  - #1815: Calendar not working properly throughout admin panel back-office.
  - #1825: Fatal error on admi
